A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Gungan''' was the [[Gungan Security Chief|Security Chief]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], and was responsible for security concerns in [[Gungan society]]. At the [[Battle of the Sacred Place]] and just before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], the Security Chief participated in a short duel with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. He employed [[Booma/Legends|boomas]] and an [[Electropole/Legends|electropole]] in battle, and also ordered [[Militiagung/Legends|militiagungs]] to attack. The Jedi defeated him and were allowed access to [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Gungan Security Chief appears in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles]]''.
